nl: 调班申请管理：查询有条件员工姓名、调班日期；表格展示员工姓名、调班日期、申请类型（调班/换班）、调班原因；支持新增、编辑、删除。表单里「调班原因」在申请类型选为「换班」时隐藏（换班的理由由对方填写）。
nlEn: Shift-swap request management: query by employee name and swap date; the table shows employee name, swap date, request type (duty-swap / rotation-swap), and swap reason; supports add, edit, and delete. In the form, "swap reason" is hidden when the request type is "rotation-swap" (the counterparty fills in the reason).
notes: AI-06: isHidden op=eq — 换班时隐藏调班原因（vue3/schema）
